frame.definition: table-local x=image right, y=toward rear wall, z=up; origin at table center on floor
frame.registration_status: User confirmed robot and white table relocated beside the stationary computer workstation; absolute placement estimated from photo adjacency and existing room geometry.

interpretations.table.slot_width_m: Derived total minus straight length = 0.077m, assuming capsule shape
interpretations.table.slot_back_edge_distance_m: Upper table edge interpreted as rear edge by wall
interpretations.props.hole_depth_m: User follow-up 1.3 interpreted in cm consistent with original measurements = 0.013m
interpretations.props.hole_diameter_m: User specified same nominal diameter as battery, 0.0125m; no artificial clearance added

unmeasured: relocated table and robot absolute room placement
provenance.physics_model: Yellow and red foam are rigid approximations; red fixture held static based on visible tape. Nominal battery/hole diameters are equal; real compliance, contact/friction and insertion forces remain uncalibrated.
provenance.photo_layout: Centers estimated from multiple supplied photographs; approximately 1-2cm uncertainty, not measured robot-frame poses
provenance.user_scene_cleanup: Remove the white packaging box and its barcode-like decorative stripes beside the robot, per user request.

validation_scope: Scene geometry, collision openings and reset stability. No completed robotic grasp-and-insert demonstration or real-robot execution is claimed.

relocation.user_correction: Robot and white table moved beside the computer; computer workstation remained fixed.
relocation.placement_basis: White table to photo-right of stationary optical/computer desk, rear edges aligned; approximately 14mm lateral gap from modeled desk. Absolute placement remains estimated.
relocation.loose_accessories: Old headset intersecting new tabletop hidden; powerstrip moved from new robot footprint to under desk. These accessory positions are photo-based estimates.
